rgdu.note: Coefficient rounded to 4 decimals and capped at Tmin + Tdelta; zero from 3 reference SMIC. The reference SMIC stays at its 1 January 2026 value.

smic_current.source: arrêté of 22 May 2026: 12.31 € an hour from 1 June 2026
smic_current.note: Legal floor for gross wages only; never enters the RGDU formula.

contributions.source: URSSAF 2026 employer rates; S1 for the 0.49 % cap on the eligible AT/MP part
contributions.note: Full-time private-sector posts only. The reduced health and family rates no longer exist in 2026. Eligible rates below the ceiling sum to Tmin + Tdelta.

contributions.other_levies.source: training, apprenticeship tax, PEEC and transport levy; orders of magnitude by size
contributions.other_levies.note: Not eligible to the RGDU; shifts the level of labor costs, not the reform.

bands.source: target: S4, once gross (not net) distributions are at hand
bands.note: Representative gross wage of each band, in reference SMIC. S4 publishes net amounts, which are not converted here.
